from __future__ import annotations

from collections.abc import AsyncIterator, Awaitable, Callable

from ..contracts import Health, RuntimeContext, ServiceSpec, ServiceState


Generate = Callable[[str], Awaitable[str]]
StreamGenerate = Callable[[str], AsyncIterator[str]]


class ReasoningProvider:
    """Candidate generation only; never an outward-response authority."""

    spec = ServiceSpec("reasoning.provider", required=True, dependencies=("evidence.gate",))

    def __init__(self, generate: Generate, *, stream_generate: StreamGenerate | None = None) -> None:
        self._generate = generate
        if stream_generate is None:
            owner = getattr(generate, "__self__", None)
            discovered = getattr(owner, "stream", None) if owner is not None else None
            stream_generate = discovered if callable(discovered) else None
        self._stream_generate = stream_generate
        self._state = ServiceState.DECLARED

    async def start(self, context: RuntimeContext) -> None:
        self._state = ServiceState.READY

    async def stop(self) -> None:
        self._state = ServiceState.STOPPED

    async def health(self) -> Health:
        mode = "candidate_only_stream_capable" if self._stream_generate is not None else "candidate_only"
        return Health(self._state, mode)

    @property
    def streaming_available(self) -> bool:
        return self._stream_generate is not None

    async def candidate(self, text: str) -> str:
        if self._state != ServiceState.READY:
            raise RuntimeError("reasoning_provider_not_ready")
        return await self._generate(text)

    async def stream_candidate(self, text: str) -> AsyncIterator[str]:
        if self._state != ServiceState.READY:
            raise RuntimeError("reasoning_provider_not_ready")
        if self._stream_generate is None:
            raise RuntimeError("reasoning_stream_unavailable")
        async for chunk in self._stream_generate(text):
            rendered = str(chunk or "")
            if rendered:
                yield rendered
